nodes.name: cainjector-ops.yaml
nodes.summary: ytt overlay that patches the cert-manager-cainjector Deployment container image using arch and app_version data values, letting upgrade tests substitute locally built cainjector images.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Carvel ytt directives (#@ load, #@overlay/match) to merge into an existing Deployment rather than defining a standalone resource.

nodes.name: controller-ops.yaml
nodes.summary: ytt overlay that rewrites the cert-manager controller Deployment image from the supplied arch and app_version values, enabling upgrade tests to run against a specific build.
nodes.languageNotes: Carvel ytt overlay matched by Deployment name and container name, keeping the overlay resilient to surrounding manifest changes.

nodes.name: values.yaml
nodes.summary: ytt data-values schema stub exposing app_version for the upgrade overlay set; the concrete value is injected at render time by the test harness.

nodes.name: webhook-ops.yaml
nodes.summary: ytt overlay that replaces the cert-manager webhook Deployment container image using arch and app_version, so upgrade tests exercise a candidate webhook build.
nodes.languageNotes: Carvel ytt overlay targeting a single container by name inside the webhook Deployment.
